name: Medicine shortages
value: UK SSPs in force; no widespread rationing
summary: UK Serious Shortage Protocols cover lansoprazole, Estradot and Creon; no widespread rationing found
state: NHSBSA lists Serious Shortage Protocols for lansoprazole orodispersible tablets from 9 Sep to 15 Jan 2027, and for Estradot patches and Creon 25000 capsules to 8 Jan 2027 after amendments on 2 Oct. In the US, ASHP counted 227 active shortages in the second quarter of 2026, a third straight quarterly rise (AJMC, 20 Jul). Searches on 8 Nov found no widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
for_you: NHS patients affected by a protocol may receive an alternative product or quantity from the pharmacist. The NHS and NHSBSA publish current protocols; prescribers and pharmacists can advise.
rubric_hit: Watch: UK Serious Shortage Protocols in force for widely used medicines (lansoprazole, Estradot, Creon); no widespread rationing
basis_detail: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists
basis_by: FDA, EMA and NHSBSA shortage lists

sources.title: AJMC — Active US drug shortages rise for third straight quarter

why: Shipping disruption, factory failures and export curbs can leave essential medicines short, as with US IV fluids after Hurricane Helene in 2024.
drivers: Manufacturing concentrated in India and China, shipping, raw materials, demand spikes, regulation.

rubric.alert: Shortages forcing widespread rationing or cancelled treatment across major health systems.
rubric.watch: A shortage of an essential medicine or supply across several countries, or a UK Serious Shortage Protocol for a widely used medicine.
rubric.normal: No widespread shortages of essential medicines in major health systems.
